name: Jaroslav Novák
bio:
Jaroslav's fascination with electronics began in his youth, tinkering with radios and building his own circuits. He honed his skills at the Czech Technical University in Prague, specializing in embedded systems. After graduating, he spent several years in the automotive industry, developing advanced control systems before making the leap to motorsport. 

He joined Racing Start Academy five years ago, drawn by the challenge of optimizing performance through cutting-edge electronics. Jaroslav is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to troubleshoot complex problems under pressure. He believes in a holistic approach, understanding how each electronic component contributes to the overall vehicle performance. 

What sets Jaroslav apart is his relentless pursuit of improvement. He is never satisfied with the status quo and constantly seeks new ways to push the boundaries of what's possible, blending proven reliability with calculated innovation.
